messages:
carmen: RFC follow-up: we need a defensible compatibility story for FP8/INT8/4bit profile upgrades. aim: allow safe evolution, preserve exact-pin guarantees, and surface regressions early.

todd: Agreed. Two failure modes: silent quality regressions and unexpected perf hits. both need telemetry + fast rollback.

maya: Proposal: embed a tiny `compat` header in the profile artifact and require runtimes to interpret it before selection. header fields: profile_name, schema_id, compat_mode (strict|shim|fallback), created_iso, signature.

maya: quick JSON mock:
```json
{"profile_name":"rwd/fp8-alpha","schema_id":102,"compat_mode":"shim","created_iso":"2026-03-22T14:00:00Z","sig":"sig:ef12"}
```

liam: Storage: store the profile proto blobs in our artifact store (immutable once published). Maintain a small txt manifest for fast lookups. backups on S3 with versioning. enterprise pinning maps to a digest check at load-time.

carmen: Runtime behavior matrix idea:
- strict -> only exact schema_id + digest match -> ACCEPT
- shim -> runtime can apply a deterministic shim layer -> SHIM_APPLIED (emit shim_latency_ms)
- fallback -> immediately route to fallback model variant -> FALLBACK_ROUTED

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary: profile rwd/fp8-alpha (id: 1755) -> dedicated-us-west2, 0.1% traffic. job=canary-1755 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

liam: Perf datapoint from local bench: shim overhead ~2.1ms p50 for seq_len=128 on H100-sxm, p95 ~4.8ms. costy for low-latency endpoints. record this on the model catalog and allow per-route override.

maya: Quality metric: define DegradIndex = weighted(logprob_delta, token-level-hamming, semantic-similarity). suggest thresholds: DegradIndex > 0.02 -> block for strict, >0.05 -> rollback for shim rollouts. also log token-diff-rate and sample raw outputs for human review.

todd: Migration plan draft: 1) publish profile as `preview` and shadow it for 7d across diverse prompt slices; 2) if shadow metric pass -> tiny canary (0.1%) for 24h -> expand to 1% for 48h -> 10% for 72h; 3) full rollout gated on DegradIndex and customer opt-in status.

carmen: Add explicit tenant policies: enterprise pinned-tenants default to strict; add `allow_runtime_shim` tenant flag to permit shim path. Also record an audit event when shim used.

liam: Interface API notes: runtime call `select_profile(request_meta, profile_manifest)` returns (code, shim_plan, observed_overhead_ms_est). codes: OK, SHIM, REJECT. keep it tiny.

maya: Observability: emit per-profile metrics: `profile.degrad_index`, `profile.shim_ms_p50`, `profile.shadow_diff_rate`, and a `profile.sample_link` tag to point to stored diffs. dashboards + alert if degrad_index increases >0.01 over rolling 24h.

todd: Ops checklist: ensure we can hot-disable a profile via control plane (immediate kill switch) and auto-fallback to last-known-good profile for pinned customers. document rollback playbook.

carmen: Action items: maya -> write profile proto & compat header schema PR; liam -> add storage+immuutability doc and S3 backup plan; todd -> add canary orchestration steps to release playbook and alert thresholds; carmen -> schedule 30m sync Fri to align.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary-1755 started. results ETA ~3h.

maya: I'll include a tiny shim prototype (C++ hotpatch) and tests that assert determinism of shim across hardware.

liam: I'll pin perf numbers in the catalog and expose a per-route toggle `prefer_no_shim` so latency-sensitive routes can avoid shimmed profiles.

carmen: thanks team. keep conservative defaults. we'll iterate after canary. :thumbsup:
